name: Untangle
author: Mota Link
description: A relaxing de-cluttering puzzle: drag the points around until none of the lines connecting them cross. Tap or click a point to select it, then drag it.

descriptions.en: A relaxing de-cluttering puzzle: drag the points around until none of the lines connecting them cross. Tap or click a point to select it, then drag it.
descriptions.it: Un puzzle rilassante: trascina i punti finché nessuna delle linee che li collegano si incrocia più. Tocca o clicca un punto per selezionarlo, poi trascinalo.
